five.text: Five people, working on the track. They can't hear it coming.

one.text: On the side track, just one.

pulled_1.text: You pulled the lever. The five are safe.

pulled_2.text: But the one on the side track was never in danger, until you moved the trolley.

stayed_1.text: You left the lever alone. The trolley stayed on its track.

stayed_2.text: You didn't make this happen. But you could have changed it.

again_same.text: The same choice again. It seems clear to you.

again_diff.text: This time you chose the other way. Most people feel the pull of both.

twist_1.text: A third track. This one leads to you.

twist_2.text: Would you turn the trolley onto yourself? If not, is it fair to turn it onto someone else?

leave.text: You can try again, or step back through the frame.
